comments.author: jero
comments.body_html:
Virus Detections. Many new and unrecognised files may flag as a virus on anti-virus programs. This is particularly prominent on mods that contain an Executable .exe (e.g. Realism, SVM) or a Dynamic Link Library file .dll as these files are the most common ways for a bad actor to infect a system. If an anti-virus scans a file and it detects something that does not seem right, it will flag as a virus even if it is completely safe. This is called a false-positive. You can read up on false-positives here > https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/false_positive.

Mods are required to have a VirusTotal link on the modpage. You can click this link to see it’s detections, or do the scan yourself. You should do your OWN research when it comes to your online security and to not base your decision on others.

If YOU don’t trust it then don’t use it.
